tolerance.note: analytic reference, so the only error is the recycle's convergence tolerance (0.01% default on the tutorial page); 0.5% allows for the loop not being converged to its last digit

scenarios.why: the tutorial's own exercise: a 50/50 split; the analytic flows change with the split ratio (mixed = fresh / ratio), so each scenario carries its own expected values
a smaller recycle share (10%), where the loop converges quickly
a large recycle share (80% returned): the tutorial says such a loop can take tens of passes with direct substitution, so this tests convergence, not only arithmetic

review.method: expected values derived from the tutorial's mass-balance statement; closure checked by hand (product = fresh)
